name: What are the common signs of water damage from a leak?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs of water damage from a leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of water damage include visible water stains on walls or ceilings, peeling paint, warped flooring, or a musty odor. Even if you don't see standing water, these indicators suggest a hidden leak. Early detection is crucial, as delayed action can lead to more extensive damage and repair costs. Maine Results, Inc. assesses the full scope of damage to ensure a comprehensive repair plan.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for water stains, peeling paint, warped floors, or a musty smell as signs of water damage from a leak.
